name: Rim Herders
description: Rim independents live with the creature herds: the Ossuvan herders' herds are docile to them and defend them, their tamed freighters shrug off storms, and their ports are the only steady source of herd goods. Protect a herd range and win a protectorate, conquer it and face feral herds, or steal the herding craft.
